question: Can an EEG model be asked its questions in words, including ones it was never trained on?
metric_units: Balanced accuracy, AUROC, flip rates and chance levels are proportions in [0,1], and so are levels and descriptive contrasts. An entry with unit "difference of proportions" is the language arm minus the reference (or the reworded minus the training wording), stored as a proportion: multiply by 100 for percentage points, the unit the margin of 2 pp is in. Unit "difference of AUROC" is a difference of AUROC. Unit "log R" is the natural log of R, the head's remaining error (1 - AUROC) over the read-off's, and r gives R itself. Log loss is mean binary cross-entropy in nats. Counts of people, seeds, fits, intervals and cells are whole numbers.
scope: Route 3 of the decision-research roadmap: one question-conditioned head asked each question by a question number, a label template or a description. Seen questions in their training wording, rewordings and questions the EEG head was never trained on are separate results, never pooled. Every figure compares set-ups; none is a deployment error rate. Every BOAS figure travels with the three stated gaps and the attribution in boas_conditions. The wording lists, the held-out partition and the derangements are in questions-in-language-wordings.json.

questions-in-language.title: Route 3, questions in language: task identifiers, label templates and natural-language descriptions

route.site_text: Compare task identifiers, label templates and natural-language descriptions. Paraphrases and unseen concepts are tested separately and never merged into one zero-shot number.
route.boundary: Questions about negation, location or waveform shape need signal-level ground truth. Writing more prompts does not supply it.

origin.cite: Yu & Yao, 2026 · Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
origin.note: an interface pattern from a vision paper; route 3 is not an integration with Jev and not a Jev model that reads EEG

route.jev_scope: “Jev-style” names an interface pattern: encode the signal once, then answer several explicit, typed questions about it. This is not an integration with Jev and not a Jev model that reads EEG.
route.independence: BCI Report is independent and not affiliated with the Jev authors; no contact with them and no endorsement by them is claimed.

design.unseen_definition: Unseen by the EEG head: no training row carries the concept's label, rows whose label is that concept are not used for training, scaling or batch sampling, and its name, synonyms and wordings appear in no training text. The frozen text encoder has read the words. For SSVEP, every text token of a held-out frequency occurs in that rotation's training texts, so only the combination is new.

ID.vector: one-hot over the K seen predicates (full rank)

TPL.vector: standardised frozen 384-d text embedding of a training frame filled with a label name

DESC.vector: standardised frozen text embedding of a description

SHUF.vector: TPL embeddings attached to the wrong seen predicates by declared derangements; unseen predicates get their true TPL embedding

NUM.vector: 23-d smooth code: (f-11.9)/2.309 (mean, SD of the 40 grid values) plus 22 Gaussian bumps sigma 0.4 Hz centred 7.9, 8.3, ..., 16.3 Hz

B-sh.vector: none: one output per seen question
B-sh.role: reference: shared hidden layer, one output per seen predicate, BCE per predicate (route 2's design, not route 2's numbers)

design.head: One head for every arm: standardised features → Linear(d→64) + LayerNorm → FiLM from the question vector → ReLU, dropout 0.25 → one output; binary cross-entropy per (window, seen predicate); AdamW 1e-3, batch 256, 30 epochs (60 for every SSVEP arm by the declared fit-check fallback); no validation set, no early stopping.
design.text_encoders_note: Frozen at pinned commits and never redistributed.

margins.p3_definition: R = mean over people (1-AUROC) language arm / same for prior-corrected read-off; non-inferior if upper bound of log R < log 1.25
margins.fixed: at freeze, before any fit; no pilot

flags.margin: equivalent within delta if interval inside (-delta,+delta); non-inferior if the bound in the language arm's disfavour clears the margin; else margin not met
flags.inconclusive: no difference and margin not met

always: name domain and level ('frozen CBraMod features' or 'a plain spectrum')
unseen sentences carry 'unseen by the EEG head, not by the text encoder'
never pool rewording and unseen results

first_match_order.if: difference against the language arm and margin not met

first_match_order.then: '{subject} did better by {x} [{lo}, {hi}]' + ', within the margin of equivalence' if equivalent
'{subject} showed no measurable difference (equivalent within the {margin}).'
'{subject} was not worse by more than the {margin}.'

route_sentence_rules.conjunctions: a summary over several entries only when all reach the same rule; otherwise one sentence per entry

design.uncertainty: Hierarchical paired bootstrap: 2,000 draws, seed 20261007; people (BOAS by person), then seed indices within each outer fold (shared across SSVEP rotations), then held-out wordings within kind for a1 (12 frames), a3 (10 descriptions) and the unseen descriptions; the three a2 synonym indices are fixed. Percentile 95% intervals. Single-seed entries resample people only and carry no training-run variance.
design.multiplicity: 35 pre-declared comparisons, not corrected for multiplicity; each interval is a 95% interval for its own comparison.
design.a2_note: a2 entries rest on three fixed synonyms; worded 'for these three synonyms'
design.metric_note: Per-person accuracy is averaged equally over people; it compares set-ups and is not a deployment error rate.
design.freeze: Protocol frozen 2026-10-07 13:37 UTC; amended at stage 0b (wording hashes, canary revisions 4 and 5) and once for engineering (EA-1) before the first stage-1 fit; every key that defines the 35 entries is identical throughout. Test labels were masked until each block's frozen-predictions manifest was logged. Nothing was selected on test results; no fit failed and nothing was re-run.

key_findings.en: Sleep (BOAS, 100 people, frozen CBraMod features, 3 seeds): asking the seen five-stage question with a label template or a description instead of a question number made no measurable difference. TPL - ID -0.05 pp [-0.70, +0.61], DESC - ID +0.02 pp [-0.59, +0.62]; both equivalent within the 2-pp margin.
key_findings.zh: 睡眠（BOAS，100 人，冻结 CBraMod 特征，3 个种子）：问已见过的五期问题时，用标签模板或描述代替题号，没有可测差别。TPL − ID -0.05 个百分点 [-0.70, +0.61]，DESC − ID +0.02 个百分点 [-0.59, +0.62]；两者都在 2 个百分点的界值内等效。

key_findings.en: SSVEP (BETA, 70 people, 3 seeds, 5 rotations): on the seen 32-way task, language cost accuracy at both levels. TPL - ID -5.96 pp [-6.84, -5.08] on a plain spectrum (L0) and -3.49 pp [-4.10, -2.93] on frozen CBraMod features (L1); DESC - ID -5.46 and -3.37 pp. Margin not met in all four.
key_findings.zh: SSVEP（BETA，70 人，3 个种子，5 种留出轮换）：在已见过的 32 选 1 任务上，用语言提问在两个层级上都有代价。TPL − ID 在普通频谱（L0）上为 -5.96 个百分点 [-6.84, -5.08]，在冻结 CBraMod 特征（L1）上为 -3.49 个百分点 [-4.10, -2.93]；DESC − ID 为 -5.46 和 -3.37 个百分点。四项都未达界值。

key_findings.en: Rewording a seen question (BOAS): a new sentence frame cost nothing measurable (-0.46 pp [-1.33, +0.16], equivalent), but the three synonyms per stage cost 12.60 pp [11.43, 13.74] and new descriptions 20.87 pp [13.71, 29.49]. On BETA rewording lowered accuracy by 1.33 to 4.13 pp; only the L1 synonyms stayed within the 2-pp margin. Rewording and unseen questions are separate rows, never pooled.
key_findings.zh: 改写已见过的问题（BOAS）：换一个新句式没有可测代价（-0.46 个百分点 [-1.33, +0.16]，等效），但每期 3 个同义词让准确率下降 12.60 个百分点 [11.43, 13.74]，新描述下降 20.87 个百分点 [13.71, 29.49]。BETA 上改写的代价为 1.33 到 4.13 个百分点，只有 L1 的同义词留在 2 个百分点界值内。改写与未见问题分开列出，从不合并。

key_findings.en: Unseen sleep questions (asleep; N1, N2 or N3 sleep; light sleep), never trained by the EEG head: in all 8 wording conditions the head fell short of adding up its own stage answers, by a ratio of remaining error R from 2.42 [2.07, 2.85] (N1, N2 or N3 sleep, explicit wording) to 33.80 [23.09, 52.82] ("asleep").
key_findings.zh: 未见过的睡眠问题（睡着了吗；是否 N1、N2 或 N3 期；是否浅睡），EEG 分类头从未训练过：8 种问法下，分类头都不如把它自己的各期答案加起来，剩余误差之比 R 从 2.42 [2.07, 2.85]（N1、N2 或 N3 期，显式问法）到 33.80 [23.09, 52.82]（“睡着”）。

key_findings.en: Unseen flicker frequencies (BETA): asked about a frequency it was never trained on, the head fell far short of CCA, which needs no training: 52.21 pp and 61.94 pp in the 8-way at L0 and L1 (head 28.7% and 19.0%, CCA 80.9%; chance 12.5%). It also did worse than averaging its own answers for the two neighbouring seen frequencies, and worse than a numeric code of the frequency, at both levels.
key_findings.zh: 未见过的闪烁频率（BETA）：问到从未训练过的频率时，分类头远不如无需训练的 CCA：8 选 1 在 L0 和 L1 上分别低 52.21 和 61.94 个百分点（分类头 28.7% 和 19.0%，CCA 80.9%；随机水平 12.5%）。在两个层级上，它也不如把相邻两个已见频率的答案取平均，也不如用数字编码表示频率。

key_findings.en: Is the wording-stage link used? For explicit wordings ("N1 or N2 sleep") yes: attaching the same templates to the wrong stages lowered unseen AUROC by 0.629 [0.603, 0.654]. For implicit names ("asleep", "light sleep") it was not shown: the wrong-stage control scored higher by 0.378 [0.253, 0.501], and the head ranked windows in reverse (AUROC 0.317 for "asleep", 0.244 for "light sleep").
key_findings.zh: 分类头是否用到了“问法—分期”的对应关系？显式问法（如“N1 或 N2 期睡眠”）用到了：把同样的模板接到错误的分期上，未见问题的 AUROC 降低 0.629 [0.603, 0.654]。隐式名称（“睡着”“浅睡”）没有显示出用到：错配对照反而高 0.378 [0.253, 0.501]，分类头的排序是反的（“睡着”AUROC 0.317，“浅睡” 0.244）。

key_findings.en: Negation (boundary probe, BOAS): "not X" wordings and "non-REM sleep" were answered as if they asked for X (AUROC 0.021 to 0.135 against the truth of the negated question; "non-REM sleep" 0.048). Writing more prompts does not supply signal-level ground truth.
key_findings.zh: 否定（边界探针，BOAS）：“不是 X”类问法和“非快速眼动睡眠”被当成在问 X 本身（对被否定问题真值的 AUROC 为 0.021 到 0.135；“非快速眼动睡眠” 0.048）。多写提示词并不能提供信号层面的真值。

key_findings.en: Secondary (single seed unless stated; declared likely inconclusive): EESM19 (20 people, 3 seeds), REVE-L features, the MiniLM encoder and Chinese wordings all repeat the primary pattern. On motor imagery (OpenBMI, 51 people, 3 seeds) the unseen "imagining a hand movement" came closest: R 1.08 [1.05, 1.11], a difference but within the 25% margin. On Wearable-102 (102 people, off-grid frequencies) the head fell short of CCA by 48.18 pp (dry) and 62.92 pp (wet).
key_findings.zh: 次要分析（除注明外为单种子；预先声明多半不确定）：EESM19（20 人，3 个种子）、REVE-L 特征、MiniLM 文本编码器和中文问法都重复了主分析的模式。运动想象（OpenBMI，51 人，3 个种子）上的未见问题“想象一个手部动作”最接近读出：R 1.08 [1.05, 1.11]，有差别但在 25% 界值内。Wearable-102（102 人，频率不在 BETA 网格上）上分类头比 CCA 低 48.18 个百分点（干电极）和 62.92 个百分点（湿电极）。

key_findings.en: Pre-run checks, disclosed: the training-label permutation canary failed twice before any result (revision 3: 1 of 38 intervals; revision 4: 3 of 38, all on BOAS, one below chance). The owner approved revision 5, overriding revision 4's "no further revision": 20 heads per configuration, exact per-person chance and a two-level bootstrap; it passed (0 of 38). The failure pattern fits an interval that was too narrow for a single head rather than a leak: single shuffled-label heads missed chance in both directions (66 above, 59 below of 760). The token rule for the Chinese encoder was reported instead of stopping the run (S0b-6).
key_findings.zh: 运行前检查（已披露）：训练标签置换金丝雀在任何结果出来之前失败过两次（修订 3：38 个区间中 1 个；修订 4：38 个中 3 个，全在 BOAS 上，其中 1 个低于随机水平）。所有者批准了修订 5，并推翻了修订 4 写的“不再修订”：每个配置训练 20 个头，用每人的精确随机水平，做两层 bootstrap；结果通过（38 个中 0 个）。失败更像是检查本身的区间太窄，而不是泄漏：单个打乱标签训练出的头在两个方向上都会偏离随机水平（760 次中 66 次偏高、59 次偏低）。中文编码器的分词规则改为报告而不停止运行（S0b-6）。

key_findings.en: The declared numeracy prediction did not activate: its premise (Spearman rho below 0.3 for every training frame of bge-small-en-v1.5) was false (0.53 to 0.59). The 8-way TPL - NUM flag reads "NUM higher" at both levels anyway.
key_findings.zh: 预先声明的“数感”预测没有触发：它的前提（bge-small-en-v1.5 的每个训练句式 Spearman rho 都低于 0.3）不成立（0.53 到 0.59）。尽管如此，8 选 1 的 TPL − NUM 差别标记在两个层级上都是“NUM 更高”。

pre_run_checks.disclosure: Two failed pre-run checks and two owner-approved revisions, disclosed. (1) The first training-label permutation canary (protocol revision 3; labels permuted within each training person; one head per cell) failed at stage 0b on 2026-10-07: one of its 38 99.9% person-bootstrap intervals excluded chance (sleep, L1, SHUF arm, unseen "light sleep", explicit wording). The run stopped. (2) On 2026-10-08 the owner approved revision 4 before any new fit: a gate canary with labels permuted across all training windows (one head per cell). It failed too: 3 of 38 intervals excluded chance, all on BOAS (sleep, L1: DESC seen balanced accuracy; TPL unseen "light sleep" with the implicit wording, below chance, and with the explicit wording, above chance); all 20 SSVEP intervals included chance both times. Revision 4 said "no further revision"; the owner overrode that on 2026-10-08 after seeing how it failed, and approved revision 5 before any new fit. Its per-person centring diagnostic was not run. (3) The revision-5 gate canary refits each of the 17 configurations 20 times (training seeds 20261007 + 1..20, labels permuted across all training windows) and compares each metric with its exact per-person chance; every 99.9% two-level (replicate, then person) bootstrap interval for the mean difference had to include 0. Its result is in the record. These changed a check after seeing it fail; both failed records are kept (decision log S0b-11 to S0b-15).

why_they_failed.en: A permutation canary refits the heads on shuffled training labels and checks that test scores sit at chance. Revisions 3 and 4 trained one head per cell and put a person-only bootstrap interval around it. A head trained on shuffled labels is still a random function of sleep features that are strongly organised by stage, so on new people its scores lean one way for everyone, up or down; the person bootstrap measures spread between people, not between heads, so its 99.9% interval was too narrow for this question. Revision 3 also permuted within each training person, which keeps each person's stage mix. The failures fit this reading: all were on BOAS, one of them (revision 4, TPL light implicit) was below chance, which a leak cannot produce, and of 760 single-head intervals in revision 5, 125 excluded the exact chance, 66 above and 59 below, with 18 cells failing in both directions; averaged over 20 heads with a two-level bootstrap, every cell included 0. This is a reading the revision-5 design tested, not a proof that no leak exists; the asserts (person-disjoint folds, no held-out label or wording in training, training-only scalers) and both conformance audits cover leakage directly.
why_they_failed.zh: 置换金丝雀（canary）的做法是：把训练标签打乱后重新训练分类头，测试分数应当落在随机水平。修订 3 和 4 每个格子只训练 1 个头，再按人做 bootstrap 给区间。用打乱标签训练出的头仍是睡眠特征的某个随机函数，而这些特征按睡眠分期分得很开，所以它在新的人身上会整体偏向同一方向，可能偏高也可能偏低；按人的 bootstrap 只量了人与人之间的波动，没量“换一个头”的波动，99.9% 区间因此偏窄。修订 3 还是在每个训练者内部打乱，保留了每个人的分期比例。失败的样子符合这个解释：全部发生在 BOAS 上；修订 4 有一个格子（TPL，浅睡，隐式问法）明显低于随机水平，而泄漏只会把分数往上推；修订 5 的 760 个单头区间里有 125 个排除了精确随机水平，66 个偏高、59 个偏低，18 个格子两个方向都有；对 20 个头取平均并做两层 bootstrap 后，38 个区间全部包含 0。这是修订 5 的设计检验过的解释，不是“绝无泄漏”的证明；泄漏本身由断言（按人互斥的折、训练中无留出标签或问法、只在训练行上拟合的标准化）和两次一致性审计直接覆盖。

The rule stops the run for bge-small-en-v1.5 and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (both pass all five primary rotations); for e5 it is computed and reported, and stops the run only for a missing token that is not a number piece (none).
